themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Surge
themes_detail.summary: Nine dead animal complaints filed THIS WEEK alone vs. 1.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (500% spike, z-score 6.71)—a sudden public health and sanitation concern affecting neighborhood cleanliness and potential disease vectors.
evidence: 9 dead animal complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.5 weekly baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 6.71 indicates statistically severe anomaly
500% increase suggests potential environmental or animal control breakdown
reporting_angles: Interview DSNY about surge response capacity and cleanup timeline
Investigate if rodent infestation or wildlife population spike is occurring in specific blocks

themes_detail.label: Street Sign Infrastructure Collapse
themes_detail.summary: Nine damaged street signs reported THIS WEEK vs. 1.2 weekly average (620% spike, z-score 8.0) plus seven missing signs last week (522% spike)—totaling 16 signage failures in 8 days, suggesting accelerating infrastructure decay or vandalism wave.
evidence: 9 damaged signs THIS WEEK vs. 1.2 weekly baseline (620% spike, z-score 8.0)
7 missing signs last week vs. 1.1 weekly baseline (522% spike, z-score 5.58)
16 total signage failures in 8 days indicates coordinated damage or maintenance failure
reporting_angles: Map concentration of damaged/missing signs—are they clustered by avenue or neighborhood sector?
Request DOT repair queue data: how many backlogged sign repairs exist in CD108?

themes_detail.label: Illegal Postering Epidemic
themes_detail.summary: Six illegal posting complaints last week vs. 0.6 weekly average (860% spike, z-score 7.72)—a tenfold surge in unauthorized advertising suggesting either organized flyering or enforcement gaps in key commercial corridors.
evidence: 6 illegal posting complaints last week vs. 0.6 weekly baseline (860% spike, z-score 7.72)
Spike appeared last week, not this week, so slightly less urgent than this-week signals
Suggests coordinated illegal advertising or enforcement resource depletion
reporting_angles: Identify what is being advertised—are all posters the same organization or multiple actors?
Interview Sanitation Enforcement on staffing levels and complaint response time

themes_detail.label: Illegal Tree Damage Wave
themes_detail.summary: Four illegal tree damage complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly average (300% spike, z-score 4.24)—a fourfold increase in unauthorized cutting or removal, potentially indicating environmental violations or construction activity gone unchecked.
evidence: 4 illegal tree damage complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly baseline (300% spike, z-score 4.24)
Coincides with high volume of building alterations filed (1,720 alteration permits in 90 days)
May indicate contractor violations during renovation projects
reporting_angles: Cross-reference tree damage complaints with active DOB permits—are violations tied to specific construction sites?
Interview Parks Department on enforcement capacity and fines issued

themes_detail.label: Helicopter Noise Skyrocket
themes_detail.summary: Eleven helicopter noise complaints filed 3 weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly average (4,300% spike, z-score 24.83)—the highest statistical anomaly in the dataset, indicating either a major event, new flight pattern, or enforcement baseline error requiring urgent clarification.
evidence: 11 helicopter complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (4,300% spike, highest z-score: 24.83)
Spike is 3 weeks old, not current this week, reducing urgency vs. other leads
May indicate special event, new medevac routing, or NYPD aerial activity
reporting_angles: What caused the spike 3 weeks ago? Was there a major event, emergency, or policy change?
Is helicopter traffic returning to normal or sustaining elevated levels? Request current week data
Interview FAA/Port Authority on flight path changes or temporary air traffic increases
